title: Convolens – Real-Time Fact-Checking & Slides
excerpt: Fact-check live conversations in real time and turn your conversations into presentation-ready slides.
content_html:
Just Say It.™

Fact check, generate slides and infographics all in real time as your conversation unfolds.

Your conversation, working while you talk.

Tell us what to ship next.

CONVOLENS ships over-the-air. New Lenses launch every week, with same-day patches as needed. Real bug reports get fixed in the next build. Real feature requests get road-mapped at the end of each week.
